notes.title: First Early Access Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194820/82da6f58a4ca9b6a465943fc8b80726b5083b0fc.png[/img]
[h3]New Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to respawn at the nearest shop using tickets. A feature allowing players to use 500 ticket fragments to revive at the nearest shop will be added.
[*] Increased healing amount when purchasing a max HP increase item.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where a clone remained after dying during the Chapter 1 boss (Duke) fight.
[*] Fixed automatic recovery being active during the Chapter 1 boss (Duke) fight.
[*] Resolved motion and position bugs when using the slam skill in Chapter 2.
[*] Fixed an issue where HP was fully restored when transitioning between stages.
[*] Fixed a bug where item shop text was not displayed correctly.
[*] Fixed a repeated dialogue issue with Lena in the final stage of the cave.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194820/c6e32bee339604c8dbf9810de60e75a3d15d04a4.png[/img]

[h3]Additional Changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Default language now adjusts based on the system language.
[*] Removed cutscenes upon death during the Chapter 1 boss (Duke) fight.
[*] Adjusted the bear recovery item in Chapter 2 to heal 25% of max HP instead of a fixed 15.
[*] Improved skill effects in Chapter 2.
[*] Limited demo version content to the train station section.
[/list]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194820/daaf998eb05340baabf6462a62c06e1a2e05ac4e.png[/img]

[h3]Balance Adjustments[/h3]

[list]
[*] HP and attack balance of Chapter 2 monsters has been adjusted (slightly increased as the chapter progresses).
[*] The damage of the Chapter 2 boss (Gatekeeper) has been decreased in Phase 1 and increased in Phase 2.
[*] The skill effect of the Chapter 2 boss (Gatekeeper) (spear throw) has been changed.
[/list]

[h3]Upcoming Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tutorial enhancements.
[*] Addition of a new map in Chapter 2.
[*] New stages and the final boss for Chapter 2 (beyond the current Gatekeeper area).
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: 📢 VEILED EDGE IS NOW IN EARLY ACCESS! 📢
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194820/ceac949fdcb4fdf606e5cf499b8d833599198ca6.png[/img]

Our studio is very excited to announce is Veiled Edge is now in Early Access!
In the Early Access, the game's possibilties expand - you can finally experience more and new levels of the "Full Dive" virtual world.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2447120/Veiled_Edge/

[h3]What awaits you in Early Access[/h3]
[b]Veiled Edge[/b] is a cutting-edge, action-packed cyberpunk platformer that thrusts you into the heart of these digital frontiers. As Rapid, a former elite mercenary turned investigator for the powerful Citadel corporation, you’ll navigate the virtual and physical worlds to uncover a shadowy conspiracy lurking beneath the surface. Alongside you is Lena, a brilliant but unseasoned hacker, whose skills can bend the virtual world to her will.

The Mission: Solve a child’s mysterious disappearance in the chaotic, hyper-detailed realms of Full-Dive VR. But as Rapid and Lena dig deeper, they unearth a twisted web of secrets and dangers that only a master hacker and a seasoned warrior can face.

A Multiverse of Genre-Bending Action In Veiled Edge, each chapter presents a new dimension of gameplay, seamlessly blending multiple genres into one thrilling experience. Jump, hack, and fight through meticulously designed levels, each offering its own unique set of challenges, mini-games, and ways to progress.

Hack the System with Lena's Genius Lena's unparalleled hacking skills will be your key to unlocking hidden secrets. Manipulate environments, bypass security, reveal hidden pathways, and amplify Rapid’s combat prowess—all through the power of code.

A Glimmering, Dystopian Future Dive into a dazzling pixel-art universe where every corner of the cyberpunk world is filled with neon-lit intrigue, digital mysteries, and a rogue's gallery of characters. Each chapter introduces new settings and challenges, ensuring that no two adventures are ever the same.

[hr][/hr]
We can't wait for you to play the game and tell us about your experience!

notes.title: Introduction to G-Star Release and Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello, this is ONW Studio.

It's been a few days since we uploaded the demo version on Steam. Thanks to your support and feedback, we were able to continue development. Thank you.

We'd like to share some updates along with a modest update schedule.

[b]The patched version will be uploaded to Steam after the end of G-star.[/b]

[h1]G-star Booth Participation[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194820/91363d5a6a8a6e36184897bd275029b8580f6aa0.png[/img]

You can meet Veiled Edge at the booth of the Korea Creative Content Agency.

Receive goods such as postcards and mouse pads when you participate in the play.
You can get a sneak peek at the new Chapter 2 currently in development.
[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194820/a568b0c65adf15e45fc6fc3ab1a1828a62aa2ffa.gif[/img]

[b]1. Improved Impact Sensation[/b]
Effects have been changed, and special attack scenes have been added.

[b]2. Improved Train Station Controls[/b]
The range of special techniques has slightly increased for smoother movement at the train station.

[b]3. Train Station Difficulty Adjustment[/b]
We've eliminated the inconvenience of having to start over after one collision at the existing train station, allowing for at least one retry opportunity.

[b]4. Security Zone Difficulty Adjustment[/b]
The maze concept seemed inconvenient for many. We've added directional signs and changed security zone damage to continuous damage.

[b]5. Chapter 1 Map Modification (v 0.2)[/b]
The map has been slightly changed to allow for more effective use of special techniques.
(Chapter 1 map will continue to be updated in the direction of allowing more effective use of special techniques.)

[b]6. Hacking Changes[/b]
There was a lot of feedback regarding the typing-based hacking. Due to the difficulty of difficulty adjustment through hacking and future support for various platforms, we have decided to suspend hacking through typing for the time being. We will strive to reintroduce it when better planning, concepts, and difficulty adjustment become possible.

[b]7. Game Title Screen Change[/b]

[b]8. Added Chapter 1 Boss[/b]
A boss with the concept of 'Cyber Psycho' has been added to Chapter 1.

[b]9. Joypad Support (Tested on XBOX One Controller)[/b]
You need to go to key settings and manually set the joystick keys for it to take effect. (Direction keys are automatically applied.)

[h1]Brief Roadmap and Additional Information[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44194820/399ba63c9d377ca4d7b036544dffd034bdefd068.png[/img]

Veiled Edge Chapter 2, an amusement park, is currently in production. Chapter 2 is expected to be completed in the second half of 23 and is under development with a goal of the first half of 24. Various mini-games and new special techniques in line with the amusement park concept will be introduced.

Veiled Edge will start Early Access after the completion of Chapter 2 and during the development of Chapter 3. Veiled Edge aims for an official release in the second half of 24 or the first half of 25. We appreciate your support, and if you join the Discord below, you can get update news more quickly.

Thank you.

[url=https://discord.gg/KP3QTGWMd8]>> Veiled Edge Official Discord Link[/url]
